```cypher
MATCH (c:Case)-[:ABOUT]->(a:Asset)
MATCH (d:Drive)-[:SAME_AS]->(a)
WHERE d.failure_date IS NOT NULL
  AND d.failure_date <> ''
  AND d.failure_date =~ '\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}'
  AND c.opened_at IS NOT NULL
  AND c.opened_at <> ''
  AND c.opened_at =~ '\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}'
  AND date(c.opened_at) >= date(d.failure_date)
  AND date(c.opened_at) <= date(d.failure_date) + duration('P7D')
RETURN count(c) AS cases_within_7_days
```
